builds.name: Reference: Health burn zones
builds.goal: Reference for Singed: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A movement-driven disruptor who draws enemies through poison, grounds escape routes and flings targets into unfavorable positions. Measure poison trail occupancy, fling geometry and grounding. Moving faster must produce additional useful poison/control, not just a faster exit that deals less damage. Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana.
builds.summary: Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana.
testPlan: Kit question for Singed: Measure poison trail occupancy, fling geometry and grounding. Moving faster must produce additional useful poison/control, not just a faster exit that deals less damage.

Start with the early core (Liandry, then Riftmaker) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Rylai does not stack additively with every existing slow; Riftmaker needs combat ramp.

The route fails Singed's stated kit question: Measure poison trail occupancy, fling geometry and grounding. Moving faster must produce additional useful poison/control, not just a faster exit that deals less damage.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Rylai does not stack additively with every existing slow; Riftmaker needs combat ramp.
Full cost 15,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Liandry, then Riftmaker. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Bloodletter's Curse, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
